comment: Written against the v2.47.0 release commit 4588d09, the installed build. The maker's manual names the jacks CLK, RST, REC V/O, REC GT and REC VEL; the panel prints CLOCK, RESET, and a RECORD group of CV, GATE and VEL, and the panel is what is written here. The panel render in the maker's documentation is stale — it shows two output jacks per track and no record velocity jack, where the installed panel has three per track and the velocity jack. There are no parameters at all: the snap and scale selectors, the eight track squares, LOCK, REC, the chase button, the loop marker, the velocity lane and every note in the grid are drawn inside one display widget, so none of them can be reached by a click for help; they are written as notes instead.
